mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO drops > 2% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on mechanism where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven mechanism where a simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases simultaneously, and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional mechanism where a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) during a recession signals worsening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases during a recession and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold-triggered mechanism where industrial production (INDPRO) falling below its 12-month moving average signals a supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO falls below its 12-month MA and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered instances.
